description: List the tables on a Eurostat dataframe canvas with row counts and column names and types; call it before eurostat_dataframe_query for the names to write SQL against, and read the columns here rather than assuming them. eurostat_query_dataset tables give each dimension a code column (e.g. "geo") and a label column ("geo_label"); eurostat_download_dataset tables carry code columns only, plus "time". Both write the same measure columns (obs_value, obs_flag, obs_flag_label, conf_status, conf_status_label) with the same codes, so they join on dimension codes and time; DS-* tables add obs_value_text for a value published as text. A eurostat_get_dimension_values table has code and label, plus level for geo (NULL for a code with no NUTS level), and labels a download's codes through a join (d.geo = g.code); staged without geo_level, a geo list holds every level, so filter level before aggregating.

canvas_id.description: The canvasId a eurostat_query_dataset, eurostat_download_dataset or eurostat_get_dimension_values response returned.

name: eurostat_dataframe_describe

canvasId.description: Canvas the tables were read from.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Guidance when the canvas holds no tables.

tables.description: Staged tables; empty when none is staged or all have expired.

items.description: One table or view staged on the canvas.

expiresAt.description: ISO 8601 expiry of this table; omitted when it ages with the canvas.

name.description: Table name to reference in SQL.
